summary: Completed frontend smoke and responsive testing for Dashboard, all seven routes, theme toggle, Deals, Bills, New Deal tabs, Finances, Follow-ups, Settings, and mobile navigation. Core UI flows passed, but Deals search does not filter the table.

integration_issues.issue: Entering 'Royal' is accepted and clear works, but all five deal rows remain visible instead of filtering matching rows.

action_items: Wire Toolbar search state into Deals row filtering; verify Bills search behavior as well because Toolbar is shared.
critical_code_review_comments: Deals renders a local Toolbar search state but never consumes it in Deals, so text search cannot affect table rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and 390px mobile navigation/layout passed, including sidebar overlay, active states, theme toggle, all requested sections, and no horizontal overflow. Recheck Deals and Bills search filtering after the fix.
rca of the issue: Toolbar owns search state internally and only updates its input/clear button. Deals receives no search value or callback and maps the full deals array, so typing cannot filter rows. The same shared Toolbar design suggests Bills may have the same unverified limitation.
